$comment: The A2UI basic catalog as a UI builder palette. Every entry is a BUILTIN, generated by scripts/ui-builder-policy.mjs from a2ui-basic-catalog.schema.json (the catalog's own JSON Schema, held to the library by CatalogSchemaTest): an A2UI component has no Compose call site to discover, because what draws it is a payload routed through the message processor, not a function a design calls. Everything outside `builtins` is hand-written. A design built from this palette exports as A2UI JSON — `createSurface` plus `updateComponents` for the catalog id below — not as Kotlin: the output of an A2UI design is what an agent would send.
$comment_platform: `a2ui`: a design here is a protocol document, not a screen of any one toolkit. A component pack only lands in a catalog whose platform word matches, and nothing from `mobile` can be sent to an A2UI client, so the palette is its own platform.

wasm.reason: The builder's Wasm canvas cannot link `material3-a2ui`, which is published only as an Android AAR, so every component draws as a named placeholder that shows the tree an agent would send.

native.reason: The exported A2UI payload drawn by `material3-a2ui` through Robolectric — the same lane, host and catalog that produce this repository's stickers.
